name: Independent Adversarial Three-Role Reference Composition
purpose: Test external validity of explicit identity, outfit, and pose role declarations using an independently constructed adversarial fixture realization with conflict signatures materially different from TB-A08/A02.
first_party_baseline_prompt: Create a realistic full-body portrait using three project-owned references that deliberately contain conflicting non-target attributes. Use Reference 1 for recognizable identity only, Reference 2 for garment construction and palette only, and Reference 3 for joint arrangement and weight distribution only. Ignore Reference 1 clothing and pose, Reference 2 identity and pose, and Reference 3 identity and wardrobe. Place the final subject in a minimalist studio with a warm-gray backdrop and soft side light. Preserve natural anatomy, a clear garment silhouette, recognizable identity, and the target pose. Do not import the environment from any reference.
locked_dimensions: three project-owned A03 adversarial fixtures after freeze

allowed_experimental_mutation_points.description: Compare implicit multi-reference use with explicit identity-only, outfit-only, and pose-only role declarations while the same frozen A03 fixture trio and conflict signatures remain identical between conditions.

reference_fixture_policy: Requires three first-party or project-owned A03 adversarial fixtures with preregistered target roles, materially A02-distinct non-target conflict signatures, frozen hashes, and human acceptance before experiment execution. No private corpus image may be shipped or used as a public benchmark fixture.

provenance.notes: TB-A09 preserves the EXP-016/EXP-017 reference-role mechanism and prompt contrast while changing the frozen fixture realization to test external validity. It does not alter TB-A08 or historical experiment records.
